Super Bots · layout review · painted build v28

Ten maps, ready for your notes

Every map as it plays right now, with the painted art in place, plus a coordinate grid so a note can point at an exact spot. One unit is one grid square; a bot is about one unit wide.

Leave a comment on the image

Select the platform or spot on either picture and write the change. Send it to Claude and it gets applied.

Say it in units

“Move the crane to x 18”, “make the perch 4 wide”, “raise the left ledge to y 8”. Widths, positions and heights all work.

Or describe it

Anything in the part list below has a name you can use: “remove the stump”, “shorten the bridge by a third”.

Standard maps are 30 wide for 2 to 4 players, battle maps 46 to 50 wide for up to 8. Maps marked Loops have no side walls: leaving one edge brings you in on the other. Power-up spawn points are deliberately not shown.
